sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Black Division gear crate (BD) is a Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A heavy transport crate with no identifying markings. Inside is a random package of Black Division equipment: helmets, body armor, chest rigs, backpacks, or protective gear. Judging by its contents, this crate was prepared for a team expected to operate far from any safe zone.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

sections.heading: Location
sections.text:
- BattlePass Season 1
- Can be exchanged for 10 aside from Classified documents

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: Each crate contains a random assortment of Black Division gear.
